Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of
motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the findings documented at intake. Over the course of nine visits,
care followed a conventional progression, beginning with stabilization, guided physical therapy, and graduated strengthening,
with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly
confirm the shoulder injury, including measurable deficits in strength and rotation that corresponded with the patient's
complaints. No prior injury to the right shoulder is known from the patient history reviewed. Billed services are consistent with
the treatment rendered, with no repeated charges for the same procedures. At discharge, the patient was improving and was
advised to continue a home exercise program with follow-up as needed.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
